    How to read the contribution

    The important addition is not merely a new terminal theorem. The external proof graph introduces an order-oblivious instance benchmark, entropy of dyadic gap-complexity mass, a universal fixed-confidence algorithm and a policy-representation equivalence. Those nodes sit between the generic probability/change-of-measure infrastructure and the BAI sample-complexity terminal. This is exactly the kind of graph-level structural contribution BanditRLlib should preserve when comparing future papers.
